component.name: RAVE
component.summary: Open music player with replaceable sources

description.p: RAVE is an open-source desktop music player built on Nuclear. It keeps Nuclear's plugin and theme ecosystem while developing an independent interface and source-aware listening experience.

ul.li: Search for music across multiple sources
Extend the player with Nuclear-compatible plugins
Customize the interface with built-in and community themes

description.p: Introduces the independent RAVE identity and default visual theme.
